children: Grupo Aeromexico renewed and expanded its revolving syndicated credit facility to $250M with a three-year term, up from $200M secured in Nov 2024. BBVA Mexico acted as sole coordinator and agent.
Adds liquidity headroom, easing near-term funding and working capital needs.
Extends visibility on committed liquidity through medium term.
Signals lender confidence and improved access versus prior line.
Strong bank sponsorship reduces execution and rollover risk.

This is a mid-cycle balance sheet move to bolster liquidity and flexibility after the 2024 facility. For a larger catalyst, watch for how the revolver supports capex, fleet or route growth and whether leverage, costs, or revenue trends improve next.
